messages:
Mira K: Hey @it-support — just finished MDM enrollment on my M2 Air but I'm getting repeated Keychain prompts when I try to install the company certs. Also FileVault asked for a recovery key during setup and I don't see it in the onboarding doc. Who should I ping to get this sorted?

IT Support: Thanks, Mira. Can you paste the device serial and the MDM enrollment ID? Also run this and paste the output so we can confirm the profile state:

```
system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep 'Serial'
profiles status -type enrollment
```

Mira K: Serial: C02X0Y0ABCDG (just posted in case we need it). Ran the profiles command — shows "MDM: Enrolled (Managed)" and one profile listed as "DeviceProfiles: pending user approval".

Jamal: Hey @Mira K — thanks. That "pending user approval" is why you're seeing the Keychain prompts. I can push a one-time temporary admin grant so you can approve the profile and install the certs. It will expire in 1 hour. Want me to do that now? :thumbsup:

Mira K: Yes please, that would be great. :)

Jamal: Done — you should have local admin rights for 60 minutes. Steps to finish:
1) Open System Settings → Profiles → select the company profile → click Install.
2) When prompted for Keychain access, choose "Always Allow" for the company cert.
3) After install, reboot and check FileVault status with: `fdesetup status`.

Mira K: Installing now. The Keychain prompt popped up and accepted "Always Allow". Installer completed. Rebooting.

Lina: Quick security check — before approving any certs, can you confirm the profile issuer is "redwood-device-ca" and that the cert lists the correct org? If possible paste the cert subject line.

Mira K: Profile issuer shows "redwood-device-ca" and cert subject is "CN=redwood-device-ca, O=Redwood Inference, OU=Device Management" — looks correct.

Security Eng: Thanks for confirming. Jamal, once Mira confirms apps/profiles load okay, please revoke the temporary admin and mark the device as compliant in the console.

Jamal: Will do. Mira — can you run `fdesetup status` and `profiles status -type configuration` and paste the output so I can mark compliant?

Mira K: fdesetup status: FileVault is On for the disk.
profiles: shows "All profiles installed — no pending user approval".

Jamal: Perfect. Revoking admin now and setting device to compliant. :white_check_mark:

Mira K: All good on my end, no more prompts. Thanks everyone — appreciate the fast help! :raised_hands:

IT Support: If anything else pops up during your first week, drop a note here or DM @it-support. Welcome again!
